verdict.rationale: Docs describe running many agents in parallel via a task board with per-card worktrees, subagents for parallel research, and CLI/headless scripting with cron scheduling — all supporting bulk/parallel task execution across many items. However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk operations, and no concrete example of processing many discrete items (e.g., batch file edits) in one command. Missing for 10: independent verification of bulk-scale reliability, a concrete large-batch use-case example, and evidence of throughput/limits at scale.
